# Moderation message — English

Hello,

I would like to submit OldShootSounds for review and publication on WGMods.

The modification restores standard gunshot sounds from the official World of Tanks 1.29.1.1 client for recognized guns on Tier I–X vehicles in the current client. It changes only firing audio events and does not alter vehicle parameters, game mechanics, aiming, visibility, timers, player information, or any other gameplay data.

The mod supports player, allied, enemy, and double-barrel gunfire. Tier XI vehicles and unknown or special firing systems are intentionally left unchanged. A hangar-only F8 test cycles through the included sound categories; the hotkey is disabled in battles.

All embedded audio was derived from Wargaming's official World of Tanks client. The archive contains no audio from other mods, no crew voiceovers, no third-party collaboration audio, no native executable, no network functionality, no telemetry, and no advertising. The included CMD file only launches the readable PowerShell installation script. The script detects the active game version, copies the mod files, and merges one SoundBank entry into `audio_mods.xml` while preserving entries from other mods.

The project source is available at `<SOURCE_URL>`. Mod version: `1.1`. Supported World of Tanks version: `<GAME_VERSION>`.

Please let me know if the archive layout, attribution, source availability, or installation method should be adjusted for Mod Hub requirements.

Thank you.

`<AUTHOR>`
